title: Can you play a provisional ball if your ball is in a penalty area?
question: If you think your ball might be in a penalty area (like a water hazard), can you play a provisional ball?

choices.text: Yes, you must always play a provisional ball.
No, you are not allowed to play a provisional ball in this case.
Only if your ball is in long grass.
Yes, but only after searching for 5 minutes.

explanation: A provisional ball cannot be played if it is known or virtually certain your ball is in a penalty area. Instead, you must follow the penalty area rules.
